newsitem.title: poland: SOCCER-POLAND AND ITALY DUEL TO SCORELESS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLAND AND ITALY DUEL TO SCORELESS DRAW.

text.p: Poland and Italy played to a scoreless draw in the World Cup group two qualifier on Wednesday as the Italian's defence again proved inpenetrable.

Italy, who have conceded only one goal in five qualifying matches, lead the group with 13 points from five matches with England second with nine points from four games. Poland are third with four points after three matches.
Poland had the game's best scoring opportunity in the 44th minute when Pawel Wojtala headed over from close range after goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi mishandled a freekick.
Italy seemed content with a draw with their strikers playing virtually without any support from the midfielders who concentrated on defence throughout the game.
